options: Increase, because a predator is gone
questions.explain: Fewer predators can mean more prey, which may damage crops.

questions.prompt: Farmers sometimes use pesticides that kill insects, but also poison frogs and birds that eat them. Using a food web, explain the possible consequences and suggest a better approach.
questions.modelAnswer: Pesticides reduce insects, which removes food for frogs and birds. Poison can also build up in animals higher up the food chain, like snakes and eagles, harming them. With fewer frogs and birds, pests may bounce back later with no natural predators. A better approach is integrated pest management: encourage natural predators (birds, frogs, ladybirds), rotate crops, use traps, and use targeted, safer pesticides only when needed.
rubric: Effects on several links of the web
questions.explain: Criterion D: consequences of human choices.
